title: The Borel complexity of non-Archimedean operator ranges
summary: We completely classify the possible complexity classes of non-closed operator ranges on separable Banach spaces over a Polish non-Archimedean non-trivially valued field. These are precisely $\boldsymbol{Π}_{1+λ+n+2}^{0}$ for a countable ordinal $λ$ that is either zero or a limit ordinal, and a finite ordinal $n$. Considering Fréchet spaces produces the additional complexity classes $\boldsymbol{Π}_{λ}^{0}$ for a countable limit ordinal $λ$.
